title: hortensia macrophylla f. isonotaki
intro: Hortensia macrophylla f. isonotaki, commonly known as an edible and medicinal plant, belongs to the Saxifragaceae family and is native to East Asia. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties that may aid in wound healing, as well as its ability to lower blood pressure and cholesterol levels. The therapeutic actions of Hortensia macrophylla f. isonotaki include its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects, which can help protect against oxidative stress and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
